description:
Job Responsibilities
 • You will work closely with the team leader and overseas developers to support the operation of the production system
 • You will develop code to fix production issues or to implement new features
 • You will help develop and enhance internal tools
 • You will create and maintain builds and manage branches and enforce source control best practices
 


 Job Requirements
 • You will need about 3-5 years of web development
 • You will need to be eager to learn and support a broad and technically rich application stack
 • Wearing a suit and tie every day is okay
 


 Longterm Contract
 How to Apply
 • Please send your application online under ettaingroup.com and contact Antonette Tubera at 97
